title: AnalysisOptions
description: Which parts of an analysis a run asks the model for, and how long their prose should be. Returned by analysis.getDefaults and taken and returned whole by analysis.saveDefaults, which is the only way the defaults change: a run's own overrides travel on analysis.run and are never remembered. A part that is off is removed from the prompt and from the response schema, so it costs nothing on any turn.

changeClusters.description: Whether a run also produces the change-clusters grouping. Dependency flow is always produced.

implementationGroups.description: Whether a run declares which abstractions were changed alongside their implementations.

risks.description: Whether a run assesses risks: overall, per cluster, per node and per edge, and the risky node state.

nodeExplanations.description: Whether each node gets what changed, why, what it affects and implementation notes. Titles are always produced.

edgeExplanations.description: Whether each edge gets an explanation. Its ends and kind are always produced.

containerExplanations.description: Whether each cluster gets a summary and an explanation. Its title is always produced.

verbosity.title: AnalysisVerbosityLevel
verbosity.description: How long the prose a run asks for should be. medium is the lengths every analysis before 1.15 was written against; brief is about half of that and detailed about twice.
